description.value:
Arasaka continues to deny claims that the Nobunaga is a modified copy of Tsunami Arms’ Ashura. They’re lying, but who can blame them? This extensive rebuild rips out the Ashura’s smart-guided gyrojet mechanism in favor of a bolt action that loads custom nano-explosive tipped munitions. For skilled sharpshooters, a single Nobunaga can forge an empire.

Cost: 3,500eb (Luxury)

Class: EQ Sniper Rifle • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Scout Rifle

Damage: 5d6 • Capacity: 8 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: 0 • Attachments: Extended Magazine, Magrail Kit (w/ Bipod & Power Rebuild), Smartgun Link, Variable Scope Mount (w/ Infrared Nightvision Scope, Long Scope, & Sniping Scope) • Mods: None

Special Features: Can only load modified Armor-Piercing Ammunition (500eb (Expensive) per 10), which also functions as High Precision and Incendiary Ammunition. After this weapon is fired, an Action is required to work its bolt before it can be fired again.

Range: Scout Rifle
Pre-installed: Extended Magazine, Magrail Kit (w/ Bipod & Power Rebuild), Smartgun Link, Variable Scope Mount (w/ Infrared Nightvision Scope, Long Scope, & Sniping Scope) (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
